user.title: Connect a developer account
user.description:
Select a brand and enter the developer application credentials. The account entry will be named automatically.

**A vehicle you share with someone else, including a family member, is excluded from the registration list even when you own it and sign in with the owner account.** Vehicles shared with you are also excluded. Check vehicle sharing in the manufacturer app before continuing.

credential_warning.title: Check developer credential format
credential_warning.description: One or both credentials differ from the commonly observed formats. A UUID-shaped Client ID and a 48-character Client secret containing only ASCII letters and numbers are typical. Other formats may still be valid. Continue to use these credentials, or go back to check them.

authorize.title: Authorize {brand}
authorize.description:
**A vehicle you share with someone else, including a family member, is excluded from the registration list even when you own it and sign in with the owner account.** Vehicles shared with you are also excluded. Check vehicle sharing in the manufacturer app before continuing.

Confirm that the Account API Redirect URL is saved as `{redirect_uri}` in the developer console. Open the [authorization page]({authorization_url}), sign in with your {brand} connected-service account, and approve vehicle access. Paste the entire final redirected URL containing `code` and `state`. An example.com page error can be ignored only after you reach that final address with both values.

If you cannot proceed on the provider page, leave the URL empty and select the help option below.

data.authorization_help: I cannot proceed with provider login or vehicle consent

vehicle.title: Select a vehicle
vehicle.description: Choose one vehicle authorized for this account.

vehicle_name.title: Name the vehicle
vehicle_name.description: Choose a Home Assistant name for {vehicle}.

manual.title: Enter vehicle manually
manual.description: Use this only if you know the Car ID returned by the provider API. A Car ID is not a VIN. Manual entry cannot bypass vehicle-sharing restrictions, account permissions, or consent.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate account
reauth_confirm.description: This account can no longer refresh its access token. Continue to authorize it again using the saved developer credentials.

reconfigure.title: Update developer credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the developer application credentials for this existing brand. Leave Client secret empty to retain it.

validation_retry.title: Retry account validation
validation_retry.description: Authorization succeeded, but the vehicle list could not be checked. Continue to retry without repeating login.

recovery.title: Resolve a setup problem
recovery.description:
Read the [troubleshooting guide]({troubleshooting_url}.en.md), then choose an action. Retry repeats the failed check. Sign in again starts a new authorization attempt.

You can copy this diagnostic summary into a support request. It contains no account details, vehicle identifiers, authorization codes, or tokens.

`{diagnostic}`

partial_authorization.title: Review access to existing vehicles
partial_authorization.description: {count} existing vehicles are missing from the newly authorized list. Their configuration will be retained, but their data requests may fail. Submit without selecting the option below to sign in again for all vehicles. Select it to continue with the current access.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the vehicle API.
error.invalid_auth: Authorization failed. Start again and paste a newly redirected URL.
error.invalid_client_id: Enter the Client ID issued for this developer project, not a sample placeholder.
error.invalid_client_secret: Enter the Client secret issued for this developer project, not a sample placeholder.
error.invalid_redirect_uri: Enter a valid HTTPS redirect URI.
error.invalid_vehicle: {operation} returned an unrecognized vehicle-data error. Retry, then run the same API sample test in the developer console and report its error code if the problem continues.
error.vehicle_invalid_request: {operation} error 4002 (Invalid Request): the provider rejected the car ID or request. Select the discovered vehicle again; report an integration issue if it continues.
error.vehicle_invalid_header: {operation} error 4011 (Invalid Authorization Header): authorize the account again with a newly generated redirect URL.
error.vehicle_invalid_session: {operation} error 4012 (Invalid Session): the provider session expired. Authorize the account again and retry.
error.vehicle_service_terms_required: {operation} error 4014 (No Service Term): the developer project has no required service terms. Check the project terms in the developer console or contact provider support.
error.vehicle_unauthorized_client: {operation} error 4016 (Unauthorized Client): verify the brand, Client ID, and Client Secret, then authorize the account again.
error.vehicle_unregistered_user: {operation} error 4043. Sign in with the Bluelink, Kia Connect, or Genesis Connected Services contract holder account for this vehicle.
error.vehicle_not_registered: {operation} error 4046. The provider could not find a registered vehicle. A vehicle shared with someone else is excluded from the authorization list even when you own it. Check sharing in the manufacturer app and vehicle activation in the developer console, then authorize again.
error.vehicle_precondition_required: {operation} error 4120 (Pre-operation Required): finish vehicle activation and all account/data consent steps, then retry.
error.vehicle_provider_internal_error: {operation} error 5001 (Internal Server Error): the provider failed temporarily. Retry later; contact provider support if it persists.
error.vehicle_provider_permission_error: {operation} error 5004 (Internal Permission Error): check the project's API access in the developer console, then contact provider support if it is approved.
error.vehicle_agreement_required: {operation} error 5005 (No Agreement): complete the Data API third-party information agreement for this account, then retry.
error.vehicle_permission_required: {operation} error 5006 (No Permission): approve or enable this vehicle-data API under API Management in the developer console.
error.vehicle_service_not_registered: {operation} error 5007 (Service Not Registered): register or enable the required Data API for this developer project.
error.vehicle_service_not_defined: {operation} error 5008 (Service Not Defined): verify the selected brand and project configuration; contact provider support if they are correct.
error.vehicle_remote_control_unavailable: {operation} error 5031 (Unavailable Remote Control): the vehicle state prevents this request. Start and stop the vehicle, then retry after it uploads new data.
error.vehicle_service_unavailable: {operation} error 5032 (Service Unavailable): this vehicle currently cannot provide the requested data. Check connected-service support for the model and contact provider support.
error.vehicle_gateway_timeout: {operation} error 5041 (Gateway Timeout): the provider or vehicle did not respond in time. Retry after the vehicle uploads new data.
error.vehicle_provider_undefined_error: {operation} error 9999 (Undefined Error): retry later and contact provider support with the API sample-test result if it persists.
error.oauth_missing_code: The pasted URL has no authorization code. Confirm that the Account API Redirect URL is saved as {redirect_uri}, complete login and vehicle consent, then paste the final redirected URL.
error.oauth_missing_refresh_token: The provider accepted the authorization code but returned no refresh token. Start a new authorization attempt.
error.oauth_provider_error: The provider returned an authorization error. Start again, sign in with the connected-car account, select a vehicle, and approve access.
error.oauth_redirect_mismatch: This is not the registered redirect URL. Confirm that the Account API Redirect URL is saved as {redirect_uri}, then paste the complete redirected address after login and vehicle consent.
error.oauth_state_mismatch: This URL belongs to a different or expired setup attempt. Keep one setup window open and use its newly generated authorization link.
error.oauth_token_exchange_failed: The provider rejected the authorization code. Verify the selected brand, Client ID, Client Secret, and exact redirect URI, then start again with a new code.
error.discovery_failed: The vehicle list could not be loaded. Try again later.
error.vehicle_list_unavailable: The provider returned error 4045. The vehicle list or data is unavailable, so registration could not be verified. Check vehicle activation and consent for this project, then retry.
error.no_vehicles_returned: Login completed, but the provider API returned an empty vehicle list. First check whether you share your own vehicle with someone, including family. Vehicles shared with others or with you are excluded from the authorization list. Check sharing, vehicle activation, and access consent for the same project. An empty list alone does not establish that the account is wrong.
error.provider_authorization_help: If the provider shows “No registered vehicles”, first check whether you share your own vehicle with anyone, including family. A shared vehicle is excluded even for its owner, and vehicles shared with you are also excluded. If you choose to stop sharing, do so in the manufacturer app and select “Sign in again” to check the list. This concerns the provider page before code issuance. Home Assistant has not automatically detected your sharing status.
error.rate_limited: The provider request limit was reached. Try again in {seconds} seconds. No additional requests are sent while waiting.
error.account_mismatch: None of the returned vehicles matches an existing vehicle. Your saved configuration is retained. Sign in again with an account and project that can access an existing vehicle.
error.manual_unconfirmed: No vehicle data confirmed the entered Car ID. A Car ID is different from a VIN. Check the Car ID supplied by the provider API and whether vehicle data is available.

abort.all_vehicles_configured: Every vehicle returned by this account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the vehicle API.
